controls.expected_rejection: A named proton without the admitted colour structure is rejected.
Any changed source identity is rejected.
A changed prediction, census or trace is rejected.
Early target access, a local plasma fit or a precision-cutoff overclaim is rejected.
Reducing the registered spectrum ceiling below the prediction rejects the correspondence.

development_observations: The earlier SFT formula and the Parker report were known before this V3 reconstruction; no historical-blindness claim is made.
The external manuscripts do not define approximately 400 keV as an exact cutoff or report an uncertainty for that label.

evaluation_protocol.acceptance_condition: The exact propagated terminal interval lies within the complete registered Parker spectrum range, every context and adverse-formula row is retained, the precision overclaim is rejected, and the unfavorable altered-range control fails.
evaluation_protocol.falsification_condition: Reject if any source identity or registered row changes; if the terminal fraction or NIST-propagated prediction leaves the complete 67-527 keV Parker analysis range; if approximately 400 keV is presented as an exact cutoff or given an unreported uncertainty; if the broad observation is claimed to empirically select eight over every adverse formula; if a local plasma value enters the derivation; or if targets are accessible before prediction sealing.

frozen_relation.candidate_grammar: Generate the complete product of proton identity, alpha stage, all four forced mediator-sector counts, amplitude/energy/cubic powers, typed composition, rest-scale carrier, prediction custody, provenance, external comparison and extension forms.
frozen_relation.exact_domain: The admitted proton, all forced sectors two/three/five/seven and their mediator counts, the leading and terminal exact alpha rungs, powers one through three, and a post-seal proton-rest-energy/Parker comparison.
frozen_relation.statement: The terminal structural proton-energy fraction is exactly 108147617771025486368/253861190227103943729961 = 8 alpha_terminal^2. The superseded leading-rung prediction 500000/1173679081 is retained as an exact historical control.  External proton mass and Parker observations remain inaccessible until the derivation seal.

row_retention_policy: complete primary event/range/context rows, exact CODATA proton row, all forced-sector/power controls and precision nonclaim
